name: @corrplot-ng/vue
description: Vue 3 components and composables for browser-based corrplot-ng rendering

scripts.test: node --test test/renderer.test.js test/package-isolation.test.js && npm run test:types
scripts.test:types: tsc --noEmit --strict --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM test/types/usage.ts
scripts.build:browser-smoke: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --external:vue --outfile=test/browser/esbuild/vue.js --loader:.wasm=file --asset-names=[name] && vite build --config examples/vite/vite.config.js && node test/browser/assert-bundles.mjs
